You suddenly awake as a sentient toy, and you’re stuck in the dark corridors of a child’s bedroom. Navigate through the dark and dilapidated Toy Haven and DON’T LET HIM CATCH YOU. You must return to your box before the child find you and before your wind up ends (bar in the top left).

Avoid any toys as they will alert the child to turn around.

I really like turtles
